title: Agora Insights
description: A cloud-based analytics and business intelligence platform for visualizing, analyzing, and managing large real-estate portfolios. It unifies diverse data sources behind a secure, scalable backend and delivers Power BI Embedded dashboards, self-service reporting, role-based access, customizable visual analytics, and automated deployment workflows.

title: Agora Intelligence
description: An applied-AI product that generates property-risk insights through a six-node workflow. I co-designed the architecture, added precomputed benchmarks to reduce token usage, and introduced six-criteria LLM-as-judge evaluation.

title: HackerFeed Web
description: A full-stack Hacker News and AI-papers reader with saved favorites, authentication, ingestion, typed API boundaries, observability, and persistent data on Cloudflare.

title: Staff Engineer’s Path Resource Atlas
description: A filterable chapter-by-chapter index of resources from Tanya Reilly’s book, running DuckDB-Wasm and Drizzle entirely in the browser and deployed through GitHub Pages.

title: JOTE Meeting Summarizer
description: A meeting and lecture summarizer that captures audio and optional screen regions, generates concise notes, and exports the result as a PDF. I implemented most of the research prototype and co-authored its paper.

title: Face Recognition System
description: An attendance and access-management system with enrollment, database management, and real-time recognition workflows, developed during earlier machine-learning work.
